o2blast.subtitle: A Prestigious Esports Team Representing South Korea

overview.title: Team Overview
overview.desc: Founded in 2017, O2 Blast is a prestigious South Korean team that has been competing at the forefront of the scene for many years. Having produced numerous world-class players, the team possesses exceptional development expertise and an outstanding environment to discover and nurture young talent.

achievements.title: Major Achievements
desc: O2 Blast has achieved remarkable success both in domestic tournaments in Korea and on the international stage. In particular, they boast overwhelming dominance, having won multiple championships in official Korean competitions.
They remain an unwavering powerhouse, consistently competing at the highest level across eras.

initiative.title: Collaboration with REVATI
desc: REVATI and O2 Blast are collaborating to jointly nurture the next generation of players. By sharing O2 Blast's exceptional coaching philosophy and player development framework, we are building an environment where young prospects from Japan and South Korea can train and interact together.
Across borders, both teams will continue to elevate and energize the competitive scene.
